sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – our proposal for the coming period
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quote offer:70740-0 and for your letter doc:20260922-70740-P18 proposing a price adjustment clause based on AS-14404.

For a fixed-price structure we propose: EUR 5.18 per kg, payment at 90 days net, 24-month contract term, no index clause. The other terms stay as in our enquiry: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, lead time 14 days, effective 2027-01-01.

We are open to a different structure. Please tell us which lower base price you can offer if faster payment is combined with a defined AS-14404 clause (45% material share, base month 2026-08). We would agree to those terms only within a complete package at a correspondingly lower price, not separately.

At our annual review your key account manager explained that price changes above 2% need approval from your pricing committee. Please submit this for authorized review and send your complete counter as one single written offer.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your proposal and your openness to an alternative structure. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Please understand that a fixed price over 24 months is not feasible for us given the volatility in raw material costs. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

As requested, we have combined the AS-14404 index clause with a 30-day payment term and a 24-month contract, allowing us to reduce the base price to €5.70 per kg.

Our adapted Angebot includes a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €5.60 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – complete package: AS-14404 clause, 14-day payment, 36 months
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offers. We note that a fixed price over 24 months does not work for you. We propose a different structure.

For EUR 4.45 per kg, we offer payment at 14 days, a 36-month commitment at 23,700 kg per year, and the AS-14404 clause with 45% material share, no deadband and base month 2026-08. These conditions apply only together with that price. All other terms stay as in our enquiry: DAP, lead time 14 days, effective 2027-01-01.

This package gives you earlier cash, a longer committed relationship and indexed adjustment of the defined material share. In return, we ask for a lower base price. Your sales director said you will focus on customers with volume (meeting note doc:20260916-70740-M5). This is a three-year commitment at our full annual quantity.

Please obtain authorized approval for this complete package. Which term of this package prevents approval, and what is the lowest base price the authorized decision-maker can approve for these exact conditions? Please send your answer as one single main written offer.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We can approve your exact conditions—a 36-month contract, 14-day payment, and the AS-14404 clause—at a base price of €5.60 per kg. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot presents a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Regarding your reference to volume, please provide the specific volume data that supports your argument. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
